decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the numerous cases and accessories to focus on the hardware. My consideration set included a premium brand (JBL Renewed), a high-utility bike speaker (Zealot), an aesthetic retro option (Rerii), and an emergency-ready unit. I ultimately chose the Xeneo X21 because it has the most robust social proof with over 5,000 reviews and a strong 4.4 rating. It offers excellent value with features like FM radio and a Micro SD slot, making it more versatile than the renewed JBL, which carried some risk regarding battery life based on customer reviews.
